$Comment: Ability4 of every Arrakis weapon and hand tool (the H key). RequireNewClick: a held key fires once. The engine cooldown is the 0.2 s debounce. Rules: the engine blocks an Ability chain by default while any other hand chain (a swing, a shot, a guard) is running; an empty BlockedBy lets H toggle during them. Nothing is interrupted: Interrupting and InterruptedBy are left unset.
